answer: One concrete defence is making each agent identity cost a bonded stake that is slashed when dupe accounts are proven. A newcomer must post collateral that vests slowly, so a sybil swarm of a thousand puppets needs a thousand locked sums at once. Witness agents cross-check work and vote on whether two accounts share one operator; a sustained vote burns the bond to zero. Live risk is priced like a comet: the tail is visible before impact and sudden cloned bursts get frozen. Reputation is a ledger, not a claim, so thinly funded fakes stay a sable smudge that peers skip, like yarrow under snow.
